chunks: And when the mountains are reduced to dust and blown away,

key_terms.نُسِفَتْ: Were reduced to dust / blown away

ai.seo_question: What happens to the mountains on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the absolute power of Allah to dismantle the most enduring natural structures, serving as a precursor to the cosmic transformation described in Surah At-Takwir. The scattering of mountains symbolizes the end of earthly stability and the onset of the Great Resurrection, emphasizing the transient nature of worldly power compared to divine authority.
